options.name: append_roles
options.description: When true, the specified I(roles) will be appended to the user's existing roles.

options.name: defaultapp
options.description: The default Splunk application the user sees when they login to Splunk Web.

options.name: email
options.description: Email address associated with the Splunk user.

options.name: force_change_pass
options.description: Force user to change password. This field is set when the user is first created or when I(update_password=true).

options.name: password
options.description: The password for username/password authentication to Splunkd. Must be provided if I(username) is provided.

options.name: realname
options.description: The full name (comment) of the user account.

options.name: roles
options.description: List of roles associated with the Splunk user. By default this will override any users existing role membership. Use I(append_roles=true) to change this behavior to be additive.

options.name: splunk_home
options.description: Path to Splunk installation. This is used if the splunk-sdk is not installed for all users.

options.name: splunk_pass
options.description: Password for the Splunk user account being created or modified. See the notes regarding changing passwords under the I(update_password) option. This option is required when C(state=present).

options.name: splunk_user
options.description: Name of the user to create, modify or delete.

options.name: splunkd_uri
options.description: The Splunkd endpoint of the Splunk server to configure. Defaults to the local server and default splunkd port.

options.name: state
options.description: Ensure the user is either present or absent; or list the contents of the user's configuration. With C(present), existing users are updated in place. See notes regarding specific handling of the I(roles), I(splunk_pass), and I(force_change_pass).

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use when authentication has already taken place. The C(token) can be specified instead of I(username) and I(password). This module returns an output named I(token) that can be used for subsequent splunkd calls to the same splunkd endpoint.

options.name: tz
options.description: Timezone associated with the Splunk user.

options.name: update_force_change_pass
options.description: Use in combination with I(force_change_pass) to force an update to an existing user. Whenever this is set to I(true) the module will always report as changed. The Splunk REST api does not allow the C(force-change-pass) to be read.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Replace the existing password with the one specified in I(password). When I(true) this module will always report changed since there is no way to determine if the new password is different than the currently assigned password.

options.name: username
options.description: Splunk username for username/password authentication to Splunkd. When provided, I(password) must also be specified.
